body:
Private equity companies put their money into companies as a means of creating returns through growth and business restructuring. Private equity companies make investments in diverse industries ranging from healthcare to finance, IT, real estate, and consumer goods.

In publicly traded companies, having private equity means having an opportunity to gain access to capital, industry knowledge, and strategy. Nonetheless, investors should also keep in mind the size of the stake, the investment timeframe, and the possibility of any changes in ownership.

Eureka Forbes is a consumer health and hygiene firm that manufactures Aquaguard water purifiers and Forbes vacuum cleaners. They also produce air purifiers, robotic cleaners, and water treatment systems. The firm concentrates on the expansion of its product range and distribution channels.

Lunolux Limited held a 62.55% stake in the company as of Q1 FY27. It is a special purpose vehicle owned by AI Global Investments (Cyprus) PCC Limited, the Asian investment vehicle for funds managed by global private equity firm Advent International.

Novartis India is a pharmaceutical firm engaged in the promotion of medicine across different therapeutic classes. This firm functions within the competitive healthcare sector of India, and where demand for its products and regulations impact its performance. Product line and business configuration are key aspects to watch out for.

ChrysCapital Fund X held a 10.32% stake in the company as of Q1 FY27. The fund is managed by ChrysCapital, an India-based private equity firm that invests in businesses across various sectors.

WaveRise Investments Limited held a 56.45% stake in the company, while Two Infinity Partners held 3.91%. Both are associated with the ChrysCapital Group, with WaveRise operating through a subsidiary structure ultimately owned by ChrysCapital X, LLC. 

Hexaware Technologies Ltd

Hexaware Technologies is an IT services and consultancy firm that provides solutions in cloud computing, artificial intelligence, data analytics, and automation. The industries that the firm serves include banking, healthcare, manufacturing, and the travel industry. The firm concentrates on the modernisation of businesses through digital solutions.

CA Magnum Holdings held a 74.30% stake in the company as of Q1 FY27. It is owned by CA Silkie Investments, an entity formed and advised by affiliates of The Carlyle Group, a global alternative asset management firm.

Aadhar Housing Finance Ltd

Aadhar Housing Finance is a housing finance firm engaged in providing mortgages to low-income group customers. They offer home mortgages for purchase, construction, and improvements of houses. Their success is contingent upon the demand for their mortgages, collections, asset quality, and the establishment of more branches.

BCP Asia II Holdco VII Pte. Ltd. held a 64.66% stake in the company as of Q1 FY27. It is wholly owned by BCP Asia II Holdco I Pte. Ltd. and is controlled and managed by affiliates of Blackstone Inc., a global alternative investment firm.

Nuvama Wealth Management Ltd

Nuvama Wealth Management offers wealth management, asset management, investment banking and brokerage services. The firm operates in the sphere of service to wealthy individuals, high-net-worth clients, family offices and institutional investors. Its performance is influenced by clients' assets, market activity and demand for investments.

PAGAC Ecstasy Pte. Ltd. held a 53.12% stake in the company as of Q1 FY27. It is a wholly owned subsidiary of PAGAC Ecstasy II Pte. Ltd., which is affiliated with PAG, an Asia-focused alternative investment management firm.

Kolte Patil Developers Ltd

Kolte Patil Developers is a real estate development company operating in Pune, Mumbai and Bengaluru. The company develops residential apartments, premium homes and commercial spaces. Its performance is influenced by sales of properties, launch of projects, collection of payments and demand in the housing sector.

BREP Asia III India Holding Co VII Pte. Ltd. held a 40% stake in the company as of Q1 FY27. It is owned by funds and entities affiliated with and managed by Blackstone Inc., a global alternative investment firm.

Mphasis is an IT solutions provider in the spheres of digital transformation, cloud computing, artificial intelligence and application development. The company has a significant focus on banking, financial services and insurance clients. Its performance is determined by expenses on technology, client demand and development of digital services.

BCP Topco IX Pte. Ltd. held a 30.53% stake in the company. It is a wholly owned subsidiary of BCP Asia (SG) Mirror Holding Pte. Ltd., which is associated with funds managed by Blackstone, a global alternative investment firm. 

International Gemological Institute Ltd

International Gemological Institute performs gemstone certification, diamond, colored gemstone and jewelry authentication and grading services. The company serves jewellery retailers, manufacturers, dealers and consumers. Its performance is positively influenced by demand for independent gemstone certification and transparency in the jewelry industry.

BCP Asia II TopCo Pte. Ltd. held a 76.55% stake in the company. It is a Singapore-incorporated investment holding company controlled and managed by affiliates of Blackstone Inc., a global alternative investment firm.
